identity.name: Angela Wright
identity.narrative: I handle hiring and firing. Right now it's mostly firing. I wonder if my own job is next.

historical_conditioning.lesson: Remote work is possible. Government can provide. Disruption is sudden.

commitments.description: Employment at HR Director, Regional Auto Group

in_progress_transformations.description: execute the 30-day workforce vulnerability map for all four regional auto group locations. systematically audit every role — service technicians, sales staff, finance and insurance officers, lot attendants, administrative staff, parts department, management — and classify each as: (1) ev/av-exposed: tasks that autonomous vehicle technology or ev service shift directly displaces or degrades; (2) transition-ready: roles with transferable skills that could move into adjacent functions with training investment; (3) anchored: roles with durable demand regardless of ev/av adoption curve. deliverable format: structured role-by-role matrix per location, with exposure scores, estimated displacement timelines, transition pathway recommendations, and retraining cost-benefit analysis. frame the document to serve patricia's operational needs while also serving as a template methodology she will eventually need external consulting support to replicate — which is exactly what angela's consulting entity will offer.
